prompt: Nowadays, many young people are highly influenced by celebrities and choose them as their role models. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this development?
essay:
One of the most debated issues in recent years is that young people tend to follow popular celebrities as their role models without critical thinking. Some people argue that this trend affects the young generation's perspectives and values. I partially agree with the view because a growing number of teenagers are likely to purchase products endorsed by celebrities and spend excessive time watching their videos and shows.

Indeed, some critics argue that young people can be influenced not only by celebrities but also by friendships, families and communities. This is mainly because they have a natural sense of curiosity and a strong desire to explore new things compared with older people. As a result, younger individuals can be affected by a wide range of people around them. In Korea, for example, a large number of teenagers choose their parents as the most inspiring person in their lives. Beyond that, exposure to diverse information can spark younger generations' interest in a wide range of topics. Consequently, they may be less likely to focus exclusively on celebrities or be heavily influenced by them.

Although I acknowledge the aforementioned argument, I hold that teenagers have been influenced by celebrities for decades. One of the main reasons is that attractive celebrities can evoke intense feelings as if they fall in love with someone. Such a situation can lead them to have a strong desire to be like them and follow their interests and values without criticism. For example, a large number of students in high schools tend to mimic celebrities' outfits and even thoughts, which can result in hight possible to lost their opportunties to find out their own values and identities. Furthermore, during formantive stage, young people have still developed their thoughts and perspectives. In other words, they can be more vulnerable to manipulation and the influence of celebrities when they become obsessed with certain public figures.

In conclusion, I understand that young people can be independent and build their own values considering diverse topics and a wide range of people that they may be interested in, but I am of the opinion that they can be easily influenced by well-known individuals, as they are extremely obsessed with them, which can lead to the loss of their judgement and chances to explore their identities.
